metadata.title: MTT Cell Viability Assay (96-well, colorimetric)
metadata.purpose: Quantify the number of metabolically active (viable) cells in a 96-well plate by measuring the reduction of yellow MTT tetrazolium to purple formazan, solubilizing the crystals, and reading absorbance at 570 nm.
metadata.scope: Colorimetric endpoint viability/proliferation/cytotoxicity assay for adherent or suspension mammalian cells in a 96-well microplate, read on a plate absorbance reader. Cell line and test-compound treatment scheme are user-defined and not specified by the source kit insert.
metadata.estimatedTime: ~2-3 days cell growth + ~4.5 h assay (4 h MTT incubation)
beforeYouBegin: Use cells in log-phase growth and confirm the final medium volume per well is 100 uL.
Plan no-cell blank wells and untreated (vehicle) control wells; run treatments in replicate.
Keep the MTT solution protected from light; if sediment is present, warm to 37 C until clear before use.

materials.name: MTT solution
materials.specification: Ready-to-use tetrazolium (MTT) solution; kit supplies 10 x 1 mL for 1000 assays
materials.rawText: Add 10 uL MTT solution to the 100 uL of medium in each well.

materials.name: Dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO)
materials.specification: Formazan solubilization solvent; required but not provided in kit
materials.rawText: Add 200 uL DMSO directly into the medium in each well ... to dissolve the formazan salt.

materials.name: Cell culture medium
materials.specification: Complete growth medium; final volume 100 uL per well
materials.rawText: The final volume of culture medium in each well should be 100 uL, and the medium may contain up to 10% Fetal Bovine Serum.

equipment.name: CO2 cell-culture incubator
equipment.settings: 37 C during cell growth and 4 h MTT incubation

equipment.name: Microplate absorbance reader (spectrophotometer)
equipment.settings: Signal at 570 nm; background at 630 nm; subtract background from signal

equipment.name: Orbital shaker
equipment.settings: Brief gentle mixing after MTT addition

samples.name: Cultured cells (log-phase)
samples.description: Adherent or suspension cells plated into the 96-well assay plate.

samples.name: Cells with intracellular formazan
samples.description: Viable cells that have reduced MTT to purple formazan crystals.

samples.name: Solubilized formazan solution
samples.description: DMSO-dissolved formazan whose absorbance at 570 nm is proportional to viable cell number.

tables.title: Per-well reagent and volume scheme (96-well)
tables.note: Final volume 300 uL; a standard 96-well plate holds a maximum of 400 uL. Test-compound dose series is user-defined (not specified by the kit insert).

steps.action: Plate cells into a 96-well tissue culture plate at a density that reaches optimal confluency within 48-72 h.

parameters.rawText: seeded at densities between 5000 and 10,000 cells per well
reach optimal density within 48 to 72 hours

steps.expectedResult: Even monolayer / suspension at optimal density.

steps.action: Carry out the desired cell treatments; keep the final culture medium volume at 100 uL per well (medium may contain up to 10% FBS).

parameters.rawText: final volume of culture medium in each well should be 100 uL

steps.criticalNotes: Include untreated (vehicle) control wells and no-cell blank wells on the same plate.

steps.action: If sediment is present in the MTT solution, warm it to 37 C and mix gently until clear.
Add MTT solution to each well and mix by tapping the tray gently or shaking briefly on an orbital shaker.

parameters.rawText: Add 10 uL MTT solution to the 100 uL of medium in each well.

steps.action: Incubate the plate at 37 C to allow viable cells to reduce MTT to formazan.
steps.criticalNotes: At high cell densities (>100,000 cells per well) the incubation time can be shortened to 2 hours.

steps.action: Add DMSO directly into the medium in each well and pipette up and down several times to dissolve the formazan crystals.

parameters.rawText: Add 200 uL DMSO directly into the medium in each well
The final volume in the well will be 300 uL

steps.expectedResult: Homogeneous purple solution; no undissolved crystals.

steps.action: Measure absorbance on the plate reader at 570 nm and the background at 630 nm; subtract background from signal to obtain normalized absorbance.

parameters.rawText: Measure the absorbance signal on a spectrophotometer at 570 nm.

steps.expectedResult: Normalized OD570 (minus OD630) proportional to viable cell number.

controls.name: No-cell blank wells
controls.description: Medium + MTT + DMSO without cells; defines assay background to subtract.

controls.name: Untreated (vehicle) control cells
controls.description: Cells receiving vehicle only; 100% viability reference for normalizing treated wells.

expectedOutputs: Normalized absorbance (OD570 - OD630) per well, proportional to viable cell number.
Percent viability of treated wells relative to untreated control (and dose-response curve if a concentration series is used).

troubleshooting.solution: Pipette DMSO up and down thoroughly; ensure formazan fully dissolved before reading

troubleshooting.cause: Phenol red / serum interference or edge-well evaporation
troubleshooting.solution: Subtract 630 nm background and no-cell blanks; avoid outer wells or add humidity

troubleshooting.cause: Too few cells or short incubation
troubleshooting.solution: Increase seeding density or extend MTT incubation toward 4 h

safety: DMSO penetrates skin and can carry dissolved compounds with it; wear gloves and work in a fume hood.
MTT is a possible mutagen; handle solutions and formazan waste per institutional rules.
Follow aseptic cell-culture practice; biosafety level depends on the cell line used.
limitations: MTT reports mitochondrial/metabolic activity as a proxy for viability, not a direct cell count; readout can be confounded by compounds that alter metabolism. The kit insert does not specify a cell line or a test-compound dilution series - both are user-defined.
